steps.title: Craft Your Own Sonic Anthem: A WebGL Journey to Your Perfect Sound
steps.subtitle: Project Overview

children.text: This project invites users to create their own custom Sonic Anthem by interacting with an innovative WebGL-powered platform. Through a series of personalized choices, users can select various musical elements, sounds, and moods to compose a unique anthem that resonates with their personal style. The seamless integration of WebGL technology provides a visually engaging and intuitive interface, making the creative process both fun and accessible. By the end of the experience, users walk away with a fully customized soundtrack that captures their individuality, offering a deeply personalized and memorable interaction with the brand.
Mastercard’s Artist Accelerator Season 1 was a huge success. With all eyes on the project for Season Two, the question was: How do they deliver an even better sequel?

Otherlife built a first-of-its-kind immersive, fully accessible, WebGL experience integrating Mastercard’s sonic brand into a dynamic digital pass creation and claim, evolving Mastercard’s visual brand into 3D.
Working with Mastercard’s global marketing innovation team, Otherlife set a new digital standard for Mastercard’s sonic and digital brand.

steps.title: Creating a brand is a piece of cake.
steps.subtitle: Project Overview

children.text: Otherlife partnered with Cake Wallet to redefine their brand from the ground up. The new identity repositions Cake Wallet as a simple, secure, and accessible solution - with visual and verbal cues that bring its name to life. Through strategic refinement and a complete brand system, we introduced uplifting design elements, refreshed typography, a bold new logo, and a layered color palette to create a playful yet credible brand that stands out in a crowded category.

Cake Wallet had a loyal user base and strong functionality, but its brand lacked distinctiveness and emotional resonance. The name “Cake” presented an opportunity to be more approachable and memorable - but it wasn’t being fully leveraged. The challenge was to create a cohesive brand strategy that communicated simplicity, security, and delight, while helping Cake appeal to a broader audience and compete more confidently in the wallet space.

Otherlife delivered a comprehensive rebrand rooted in clarity, creativity, and consistency. We developed a playful visual language inspired by the idea of “layered simplicity” - drawing from the metaphor of cake slices to inform logo design, iconography, and motion behavior. The refreshed identity includes a vibrant color system, modern typography, and UI-inspired graphics designed to convey trust, ease, and fun across all platforms. These assets were supported by a clear brand strategy that gave Cake Wallet a stronger voice in the market.

Cake Wallet emerged with a fresh identity that’s both technically sound and emotionally engaging. The new brand makes a strong first impression, improves credibility, and gives the team the tools to scale communications across product and marketing. With a stronger foundation and distinct market position, Cake Wallet is now better equipped to grow its audience, expand awareness, and compete with leading wallets - while staying true to its name.

quote.quote: "Otherlife delivered a smart, scalable brand for Cake Wallet — clean, secure, and true to who we are. The logo is clever and beautifully crafted, setting us up for growth. Most importantly, they took the time to truly understand our business. We couldn’t be happier."
quote.author: Vikrant Sharma

steps.title: Exploring the Future of Art, Luxury, and Technology
steps.subtitle: Project Overview

children.text: The Christie's Art+Tech Summit 2024, in collaboration with MoonPay, presents a series of NFTs available to attendees through QR codes displayed during the summit. The NFTs correspond to the event’s four core innovation pillars: AI in Real Life, Thoughtful Luxury, Art and its Market, and New Paradigms in Technology. Attendees who collect all four NFTs will receive an exclusive gift from the artist Niceaunties. This project aims to merge the world of digital art, sustainability, luxury, and advanced technologies, exploring new frontiers in these fields.
Christie’s needed an engaging Web3 experience for the 2024 Art + Tech Summit, allowing attendees to claim NFTs via QR codes.

Otherlife created a seamless web platform where attendees could mint Summit NFTs using QR codes linked to event sections. The platform used HyperMint API for time-restricted minting, with a personalized "My Collection" page for viewing all NFTs, including airdrops from featured artist Niceaunties.

The activation successfully blended art and technology, delivering an interactive NFT experience. Attendees easily collected and viewed NFTs, while the event demonstrated Christie’s leadership in digital innovation.

cases.projectText: Elevating Hypernative’s brand with an interactive 3D motion design system and dynamic, multi-layered website

poster.alt: An image uploaded to Strapi called 196ae2a6c167efc6ca54368ae16fc16eb992ce3c-1920x1080

children.text: Hypernative is a Web3 security platform designed to detect and prevent attacks in real-time, safeguarding blockchain protocols, chains, and digital assets. It uses automated monitoring, risk detection, and transaction-level policy enforcement to protect users and projects from exploits before they cause damage. Hypernative’s solutions, such as its Security Oracle and Screener, have helped protect over $37 billion in assets across multiple blockchains. With a strong focus on proactive security, Hypernative aims to eliminate vulnerabilities and enhance the safety of decentralized ecosystems.
Hypernative sought to refresh their brand and expand their online presence beyond a landing page, aiming for a comprehensive website that better reflected their identity and values.

Otherlife collaborated closely with Hypernative to integrate a cutting-edge 3D motion design system into their brand. This innovative approach was seamlessly scaled across their new, multi-layered interactive website, enhancing both visual appeal and user experience.

The rebrand and expanded website gave Hypernative a modern, elevated presence. The 3D motion elements not only elevated the site's aesthetics,  but also reinforced Hypernative's polished and secure brand image. This strategic update successfully conveyed the sense of trust and sophistication that Hypernative desired, strengthening their connection with customers and enhancing their overall brand perception.

steps.title: Fusing Fashion with Iconic Narcos Aesthetic
steps.subtitle: Project Overview

children.text: The Narcos On Chain project merges fashion with digital collectibles, drawing inspiration from the Narcos universe. It offers a variety of merchandise such as hoodies, t-shirts, and sculptures based on iconic elements from the show. The collection emphasizes unique designs and limited-edition items, appealing to fans of the series and collectors alike.

To give the hit Netflix show NARCOS new life, Otherlife was challenged with developing a digital merchandise and collectibles storefront that would re-engage global fans and introduce them to Web3. The project was developed for Locke Holdings, a NARCOS IP holder.

Otherlife crafted an immersive Shopify experience transporting users to Pablo Esocabar’s iconic estate Hacienda Napoles, where they could purchase exclusive NARCOS merchandise paired with digital collectibles via NFC technology. We designed 3D versions of the merchandise collection, and digital twins for each product.  The innovative platform paid tribute to the iconic NARCOS legacy, re-excited fans, and set a new standard for e-commerce.

The collaboration with Locke Holdings and Gaumont resulted in a unique, immersive shopping experience that revitalized the NARCOS brand and offered fans new ways to experience the show. Otherlife pushed the boundaries of what’s possible with Shopify, and created an easy fan pathway into Web3 by allowing them to effortlessly claim digital twins of their purchases using NFC technology.

steps.title: Build Brilliant Onramp Experiences - A Global Brand & Product Overhaul
steps.subtitle: Project Overview

children.text: Onramper is simplifying how the world accesses digital assets. With support for over 130+ payment methods, 2000+ assets, and coverage in 190+ countries, the platform needed a refined brand and web experience to reflect its leadership in fiat-to-crypto aggregation. Otherlife partnered with Onramper to evolve its identity, redesign its digital footprint, and position the company as the category’s trusted, intelligent authority. Inspired by the brand promise - “Build brilliant fiat to crypto onramp experiences" - we restructured the site architecture, developed a flexible design system, and surfaced proof points across trust, speed, and integration simplicity.

Onramper had outgrown its brand. It was positioned as a simple widget, not as a platform. The existing site lacked clarity, trust signals, and differentiation. With expanding features - swaps, offramps, analytics - it needed a unified brand system that could scale across products and markets.

Starting from strategy, we refined Onramper’s purpose (“to give financial power to everyone”) and positioned it as an expert-led aggregator - trusted, fast, and proven. We introduced sub-brand lockups (swaps, terminal, withdraw), implemented a modular design system, and built a new web experience anchored in glass textures, bold colorwork, and asymmetrical layouts. The updated site integrates product modules, dynamic partner logos, metric callouts (e.g. “130+ APMs”), and interactive demos to showcase the platform’s API and routing intelligence. Everything - from typography to UI motif - was built for clarity, flexibility, and global scale.

The full brand and website launched to strong internal and industry-wide reception. Clients and partners now understand Onramper’s role as the world’s leading aggregator - not just a widget. With conversion-focused UX, scalable components, and consistent messaging, the platform is now equipped to onboard enterprise clients and support rapid growth. Success metrics and partner adoption - including Bitcoin.com and Token.com - reinforce the market shift toward Onramper’s unified stack.
